test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

She said, “I have finished my work.”

options.text: She said that she will finish her work.
She said that she would finish her work.
She said that she had finished her work
She said that she has finished her work.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she had finished her work.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Direct speech "I have finished" becomes "she had finished"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "she" to match the third person.
 
• Present perfect tense "have finished" is changed to past perfect tense "had finished".
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Indirect speech does not require quotation marks.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *She said that she had finished her work.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** She said that she will finish her work.
 
 
• Changes the tense to future, which is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** She said that she would finish her work.
 
 
• Changes the tense to future in past, which is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** She said that she has finished her work.
 
 
• Maintains present perfect tense, which is incorrect for indirect speech.
